title: Warranty columns on rma_cases
description: One migration adds rma_number, ticket_id, custody_id, warranty outcome/decision, closed_reason, outbound/inbound shipping, return_by, return_ship_to and replacement fields to rma_cases; re-states the status CHECK with warranty_review and repaired; backfills rma_number per tenant and seeds next_number; indexes ticket_id, asset_id and (status, return_by).
acceptanceCriteria: F001.1 — Every listed column exists with the stated nullability and CHECKs; rma_number is NOT NULL and unique per tenant for all existing and future rows.
F001.2 — Existing closed cases backfill closed_reason='resolved'; next_number for RMA continues above the highest backfilled number, so a new claim never collides.
F001.3 — Composite FKs to tickets, asset_custody and users exist and include tenant; the migration is idempotent and its down() reverses every change.

title: Append-only rma_events table
description: A new tenant-scoped rma_events table records one row per RMA transition, warranty decision and shipping step, with from/to status snapshots and a jsonb payload. It is Citus-distributed, registered in tenant metadata and the migration shim, and rejects UPDATE/DELETE via a Postgres trigger (app discipline on Citus, like stock_movements).
acceptanceCriteria: F002.1 — rma_events exists with the specified columns, CHECKs, indexes, composite FKs and Citus distribution; tenantTableMetadata and utils/tenantDb.cjs list it.
F002.2 — On plain Postgres an UPDATE or DELETE on rma_events raises an error; no code path updates an event row.

title: RMA numbering
description: Register RMA as a numbering entity (RMA-, 5 digits) in shared numbering defaults and the next_number seed, and allocate rma_number through SharedNumberingService when a claim is created.
acceptanceCriteria: F003.1 — A new claim in a fresh tenant gets RMA-00001 and the next claim RMA-00002; a tenant with backfilled rows continues above them.
F003.2 — rma_number is rendered instead of the UUID prefix in the RMA list, the asset RMA history, the RMA tag and the return slip.

title: RMA status and case types
description: RmaStatus gains warranty_review and repaired, drops dead_unit_returned (the DB CHECK stopped accepting it), and IRmaCase gains every new column. UI labels, badge variants and the status filter accept exactly the statuses the CHECK allows.
acceptanceCriteria: F004.1 — The RmaStatus union, RmaManager status labels, STATUS_VARIANT and RMA_STATUS_FILTERS match the DB CHECK exactly; dead_unit_returned is gone.
F004.2 — IRmaCase exposes rma_number, ticket_id, custody_id, warranty_outcome, warranty_decided_at/by, denial_reason, closed_reason, shipping fields, return_by, return_ship_to and replacement fields.
F004.3 — A ?status= value outside the allowed set is ignored rather than rendered as an empty filter.

title: Warranty claim state machine
description: A pure transition table in packages/inventory/src/lib/rma/ encodes the fourteen transitions of the card, including the rule that a warranty_review case cannot be closed by the generic closeRma catch-all.
acceptanceCriteria: F005.1 — Every allowed transition in the PRD table is accepted by the table and returns the expected target status.
F005.2 — Every other (status, action) pair is refused with a typed error, including closeRma from warranty_review and any transition out of closed.
F005.3 — The table distinguishes asset-only cases (returned_unit_id null) from stock-unit cases and never routes an asset-only case to a stock-unit action.

title: Open a warranty claim
description: openWarrantyClaim creates an asset-only RMA in warranty_review with a number, derived client_id, ticket_id and custody_id from the open custody episode, an rma_events 'opened' row and INVENTORY_RMA_CREATED. A composition wrapper adds the ticket record check and client match.
acceptanceCriteria: F006.1 — A claim on a held client asset lands in warranty_review with rma_number, the asset's client_id, the custody episode's ticket_id and custody_id, one rma_events row, and an INVENTORY_RMA_CREATED event after commit.

F006.2 — The action refuses an asset with stock_unit_id (pointing at the unit RMA flow), an asset the caller cannot read, a missing asset, and an asset with no client; refusals are indistinguishable from not-found where a record check applies.
F006.3 — Opening from a ticket additionally requires ticket:read and the ticket record check, and refuses when the ticket's client differs from the asset's client.

title: Approve a claim into a track
description: approveWarrantyClaim moves warranty_review to awaiting_return (standard) or open (advance replacement), writes the coverage outcome and decision actor/time, and records the chosen rma_type, vendor and optional return_by.
acceptanceCriteria: F007.1 — Standard approval sets status awaiting_return, rma_type standard, warranty_outcome covered, warranty_decided_at/by and writes a warranty_approved event.
F007.2 — Advance approval sets status open and rma_type advance_replacement, leaving the existing advance-replacement actions usable.
F007.3 — Approval is refused from any status other than warranty_review and when the outcome is not_covered.

title: Deny or cancel a claim
description: denyWarrantyClaim closes a claim as not covered with a mandatory reason; cancelWarrantyClaim closes it as cancelled or duplicate. Neither touches custody.
acceptanceCriteria: F008.1 — Denial requires denial_reason, sets warranty_outcome not_covered, closed_reason warranty_denied, closed_at, and writes a warranty_denied event.
F008.2 — Cancellation accepts only cancelled or duplicate, records the reason and writes a closed event; the custody episode is unchanged by both.

title: Mark the device received
description: markDeviceReceived moves awaiting_return to returned when the asset is physically in MSP custody. It asserts the open custody episode is in_office and writes no stock rows.
acceptanceCriteria: F009.1 — With an open in_office custody episode the case moves to returned, writes a device_received event, and leaves stock_units/stock_movements/stock_levels unchanged.
F009.2 — Without an open in_office episode the action is refused with a message that points at receiving the equipment into custody.

title: Ship to the vendor
description: shipToVendor moves returned to sent_to_vendor, records vendor, outbound carrier, tracking and return-by date, sets outbound_shipped_at, and moves the custody episode to with_vendor through C4's recordCustodyEvent.
acceptanceCriteria: F010.1 — The action persists vendor_id, outbound_carrier, outbound_tracking_number, return_by and outbound_shipped_at and writes a shipped_outbound event.
F010.2 — The same transaction writes C4's shipped custody event, so the episode state is with_vendor and the equipment queue shows it.
F010.3 — Missing vendor, carrier or tracking is refused before any write; a case not in returned is refused.

title: Receive a vendor replacement
description: receiveVendorReplacement records the inbound shipment, updates the SAME asset row with the replacement serial/model/warranty, writes an asset_history warranty_replacement row, and puts custody back in office. No asset is created and no stock row is written.
acceptanceCriteria: F011.1 — Status becomes replaced; replacement_serial_number, inbound carrier/tracking and inbound_received_at are recorded; replacement_received_at is set.

F011.2 — The asset keeps its asset_id and ownership while serial_number (and any supplied manufacturer/model/warranty_end_date) change; the previous values are in asset_history; no new assets row and no stock rows are created.
F011.3 — Custody records received and returns to in_office, and ASSET_UPDATED is published after commit with the changed fields.

title: Record a repaired return
description: recordVendorRepair records that the vendor returned the same unit repaired: status repaired, inbound shipment fields, custody received, optional warranty extension.
acceptanceCriteria: F012.1 — Status becomes repaired, inbound fields and repair_received event are written, and the asset row changes only when a warranty date is supplied.
F012.2 — Custody returns to in_office; the action is refused from any status other than sent_to_vendor.

title: Record a vendor credit
description: recordVendorCredit records that the vendor credited the device instead of replacing it, sets status credited and closes the custody episode as disposed through the new C5 custody core.
acceptanceCriteria: F013.1 — Status becomes credited with a vendor_credited event; the linked custody episode closes with close_reason disposed and an asset_history custody_disposed row.
F013.2 — No invoice, charge or stock row is created by a vendor credit.

title: Return the device to the client
description: returnDeviceToClient closes a replaced or repaired case as resolved and, in the same transaction, calls C4's returnCustodyToClient so the device leaves custody.
acceptanceCriteria: F014.1 — Status becomes closed with closed_reason resolved and a returned_to_client event; the custody episode closes as returned_to_client and the asset status follows C4's held_by_msp→active rule.
F014.2 — The action is refused from warranty_review, awaiting_return, returned, sent_to_vendor, open and credited.

title: Harden the generic close
description: closeRma accepts an optional closed_reason, records it, writes a closed event, and refuses to close a case still in warranty_review. Existing stock-unit callers keep working.
acceptanceCriteria: F015.1 — Closing a resolved case stores the reason (default resolved) and writes a closed event.
F015.2 — closeRma on warranty_review is refused; the caller is told to approve, deny or cancel.
F015.3 — Calling closeRma on an already closed case is a no-op that returns the row, as today.

title: Warranty permission resource
description: A new MSP-only warranty permission resource (read/create/update) is added to the executable catalog with default grants for Admin, Manager and Technician, plus a migration granting it to existing tenants. Warranty actions gate on it while accepting the legacy inventory action.
acceptanceCriteria: F016.1 — The catalog and migration create warranty:read/create/update for every existing tenant and grant them to Admin, Manager and Technician; new tenants get them through the catalog.
F016.2 — A technician with warranty:update can run the claim transitions; without it they get a permission error before any write.
F016.3 — A role holding only inventory:read still lists and opens RMAs (legacy acceptance), so no existing custom role loses the page.

title: Asset record gate on RMA reads
description: List and detail reads filter RMA rows that carry an asset_id through the asset read kernel, so an RMA is visible only when its asset is readable. Missing and unauthorized are the same result.
acceptanceCriteria: F017.1 — A user who can read inventory but not the linked asset does not see that RMA in the list or counts.
F017.2 — getRmaCase returns null for that case, identical to a nonexistent id.
F017.3 — Cases without asset_id (legacy stock-unit RMAs with no asset link) keep their current visibility.

title: RMA page warranty surfaces
description: The RMA page gains a Warranty review view, the new statuses, an RMA # column using rma_number, a New warranty claim action, and ?assetId= handling that opens the claim dialog prefilled.
acceptanceCriteria: F018.1 — The page filters to warranty_review and shows rma_number, warranty outcome and return_by without breaking the existing status filter or dead-unit report.
F018.2 — New warranty claim opens a dialog listing held client equipment; choosing an asset calls the claim action and the new claim appears in the list.
F018.3 — Navigating to /msp/inventory/rma?assetId=<id> opens the claim dialog with that asset selected (e2e).

title: RMA detail warranty panel
description: The existing ?rmaId= detail dialog gains a warranty panel: coverage decision, vendor case, shipping and return-by, links to asset and ticket, per-status actions, and Print RMA tag / Print return slip.
acceptanceCriteria: F019.1 — The panel renders rma_number, warranty outcome, decision actor/time, denial reason, vendor, vendor case, outbound and inbound carrier/tracking and return_by.

F019.2 — The action set matches the state machine for the current status (approve/deny/cancel, mark received, ship, receive replacement, record repair, record credit, return to client, close); actions that cannot run are absent or disabled with a reason.
F019.3 — Asset and ticket links navigate to the canonical records; an unreadable asset shows no link text.
F019.4 — Print RMA tag and Print return slip are present only for statuses where they make sense and write nothing.
F019.5 — The full approve → ship path is reachable from the dialog without leaving the page (e2e).

title: Asset and ticket warranty surfaces
description: The asset detail gains a Warranty card (warranty end, vendor, ownership, claim history, start claim), the asset list and the ticket's associated-asset row gain an RMA badge.
acceptanceCriteria: F020.1 — The Warranty card shows warranty_end_date, vendor name, ownership and the asset's claims with status and number.
F020.2 — Start warranty claim navigates to the RMA page with ?assetId= and does not create a claim by itself.
F020.3 — The RMA badge shows open claims only, is silent (empty) on any refusal, and never blocks the asset row from rendering.
F020.4 — The ticket's associated-asset row shows the RMA chip for an asset with an open claim (e2e).

title: Asset provenance RMA history fix
description: getAssetInventoryProvenance returns RMA history for asset-only claims and reports rma_number rather than the vendor reference, and the provenance component renders the case and its status.
acceptanceCriteria: F021.1 — An asset with no service_id and no stock_unit_id still returns its RMA history.
F021.2 — The history row shows rma_number; the vendor reference remains a separate field and is not substituted for the number.

title: RMA work-tag label class
description: Add the rma-work-tag label class: types, entity mapping, a standard 4x2 in template, an inventory label provider with the asset record gate, and registration in the print composition root.
acceptanceCriteria: F022.1 — LABEL_CLASSES, LABEL_CLASS_ENTITY_TYPE and the standard-template maps include rma-work-tag → rma; the standard template is registered and selectable as a tenant default.
F022.2 — The provider builds identifier=rma_number, title=device name, detail=vendor, secondaryIdentifier=asset tag, serialSuffix=last 4 of the serial, and url=recordUrl('rma', id).
F022.3 — A caller without warranty:read, or without access to the linked asset, gets null for that label; a batch skips and counts it, exactly like the other classes.
F022.4 — The standard RMA label prints on a 4x2 in cell with a scannable QR and text inside the cell.

title: Vendor return slip
description: A new rma-return-slip document type with its own bindings, sample data and standard template, rendered by a billing action and served by a session-authenticated route.
acceptanceCriteria: F023.1 — The document-template registry, DesignerDocumentKind and designer copy recognise rma-return-slip as a document type with its own binding catalog.

F023.2 — GET /api/inventory/rma/[id]/document?type=return-slip authenticates with withAuth, requires warranty:read plus the asset record check, and is on the middleware API-key skip-list; unauthenticated or unreadable returns 401/404 with no record data.
F023.3 — The slip contains rma_number, vendor name and ship-to, vendor case, device manufacturer/model/serial, accessories from the custody episode, reported fault, return_by and the RMA QR.
F023.4 — The slip downloads from the RMA dialog (e2e).

title: INVENTORY_RMA_UPDATED workflow event
description: A new domain event published after every warranty-claim transition, with schema, event-bus registration, workflow catalog reference, payload builder and catalog seed migration.
acceptanceCriteria: F024.1 — The payload schema validates the documented fields and is registered in eventBusSchema and workflowEventCatalog; the catalog migration upserts INVENTORY_RMA_UPDATED.
F024.2 — Each transition publishes once after commit with status, previous_status, warranty_outcome and ids; a publish failure is logged and does not roll back the transition.

title: Asset mutation audit
description: Every asset row change made by a claim writes one asset_history row in the same transaction and publishes ASSET_UPDATED after commit.
acceptanceCriteria: F025.1 — A replacement writes asset_history change_type warranty_replacement holding the before/after serial, model, manufacturer and warranty_end_date, attributed to the actor.
F025.2 — ASSET_UPDATED is published after commit with the changed paths; a publish failure is swallowed and logged.

title: Vendor case on the ticket
description: The RMA dialog can mirror the vendor case onto the linked ticket's external links with the tenant's custom vendor-case system, without making a second automatic write.
acceptanceCriteria: F026.1 — The action adds one external_entity_links row through addExternalLink, pre-filled with rma_reference and the selected custom system, and is idempotent for the same case.
F026.2 — Saving the vendor case on the RMA alone writes no external link; the link is only created by the explicit action.
note: rma_reference mirrored as a ticket external link using the tenant's custom:<slug> system (validated tenant-scoped in tenant_external_systems; a row existing means active; url from url_template with {external_id}, or the RMA record URL when the template is null; {realm} templates rejected); generic + RMA record URL only when no system is chosen; vendor-conversation link deferred until ticket-conversations merges

title: One label print client
description: Replace the C3 stopgap packages/inventory/src/components/labelPrintClient.ts with the shared useLabelPrint hook and delete the LEVERAGE marker it carried.
acceptanceCriteria: F027.1 — No inventory component imports labelPrintClient; the stock-unit print path uses useLabelPrint and behaves identically.
F027.2 — labelPrintClient.ts is deleted and no LEVERAGE: pattern label-print-client marker remains.

title: Localised copy
description: All new RMA and warranty copy goes through i18n keys under features/inventory (rma.*) and msp/assets (warranty.*) with entries in every locale directory.
acceptanceCriteria: F028.1 — No user-facing English string is hardcoded in the new components; the keys exist in every server/public/locales/*/ directory and the i18n completeness test passes.
F028.2 — Status and outcome labels come from keys with a defaultValue fallback, as the existing RMA status labels do.

title: No-stock invariant
description: The asset-only claim path never writes stock, cost or billing rows, and the whole Dell scenario runs end to end.
acceptanceCriteria: F029.1 — Across open, approve, receive, ship, replacement, return-to-client and credit, row counts in stock_units, stock_movements, stock_levels, product_inventory_settings, invoice_charges and time_entries are unchanged.
F029.2 — The Dell scenario from the PRD completes through the UI against the dev stack (e2e).
